symptom: Every cargo command in server/ fails immediately with: error: failed to parse manifest at `server/Cargo.toml` — Caused by: manifest is missing either a `[package]` or a `[workspace]`
rootcause: server/Cargo.toml is tracked in git but is 0 bytes. The directory layout advertises a Cargo project — src/lib-style modules and a tests/ folder — but no manifest was ever written, so cargo has nothing to parse. Twelve further .rs files under server/ are also 0 bytes.
fix: Not a bug in the code — the Cargo project has not been created yet. Build with rustc as the README documents: `mkdir -p bin && rustc --edition=2021 -O server/src/main.rs -o bin/romania_search_rust`. Completing the manifest is build step 1, which also splits main.rs into lib.rs and bin/cli.rs.
automation_gap: Cannot be gated in CI while it is the expected state. CI deliberately builds with rustc rather than cargo for this reason. Once step 1 lands, `cargo check` joins scripts/verify_invariants.sh and this entry becomes historical.
